verdict.rationale: Unity documents several first-party ways for an agent to drive the Editor. An official MCP server connects agents like Claude Code and Cursor to the Editor to perform project actions. The newer Unity CLI offers `unity <command>`/`unity eval` to drive the Editor directly, plus a `unity mcp` mode, and Editor command-line arguments automate headless workflows and builds on top of the public scripting APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation that these agent interfaces create scenes and objects and edit properties (only implied by 'project actions' and `eval`), stability (the CLI is experimental and the in-editor MCP server is deprecated), independent hands-on corroboration of an agent driving the Editor end-to-end.
